method: Manual read-only pinned source inspection; no source copies/native compilation/execution
conclusions: Panel get_extents relative to Deck contents constructs a closed tools Rectangle; positive height Bottom=top+height-1; empty height Bottom=top. Deck ShowPanel subtracts one additional pixel.

ShowPanel reads post-focus scroll adjustment, moves bottom into page size when needed, then gives top priority so oversized panels start at viewport top; source adjustment clamps via native scrollbar/browser setter.

FocusManager FocusPanel expands/focuses title and then calls controller ShowPanel; controller requests open deck and delegates extent adjustment. Browser visibility opens before DOM focus, while extent adjustment now occurs after expansion/focus.

DeckLayouter selects a scrollbar when minimum requested panel heights exceed available height outside LibreOfficeKit, and sets ALWAYS/NEVER policy. Existing browser scrollHeight/clientHeight projects current overflow eligibility only; native min/preferred distribution,LibreOfficeKit policy and full sizing remain unverified.
Managed content Escape calls FocusPanel on its registered owning display index, so the same post-focus adjustment runs. Standalone panels retain local focus behavior.
Native failed toolkit extents,scrollbar absence,DPI/rounding,full layout sizing/F6/settings/other decks/context/profile and complete native/parent parity remain unverified.
